notes.title: FlightTracker3D Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
This update contains some minor enhancements for FlightTracker3D
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the nose gear doors of the A388 model were misaligned
[*] Fixed a bug where the windows of the B753 model were see through
[*] When tracking a plane, the initial, minimum, and maximum zoom levels of the camera are now based on the length of the aircraft
[*] Fixed a bug where the gear up/down sound effect would sometimes play twice
[/list]

notes.title: FlightTracker3D Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
FlightTracker3D v1.1.0 comes with many new features and quality-of-life improvements.
[olist]
[*] A completely redesigned user interface, complete with a new custom map view, as well as a custom airports and flights search. You can now search for a specific flight, or search for an airport to spot planes at!
[*] Gear and engine animations and sounds for all plane models
[*] A custom Settings menu to change how FlightTracker3D functions
[*] General model and livery improvements, with significant improvements made to the A318, A319, A320, and A321 models
[*] Steam overlay support! You can now take screenshots using your Steam screenshot key and share them directly to Steam's community hub.
[*] General performance and stability improvements
[/olist]
